about: Every parse error task game:parse finds in the base game, classified: a defect of the game's own files (game-defect) or a fault of pychivalry's parser to fix (pychivalry-fault). Matched by file, finding id and line; an error without an entry, or an entry without an error, fails the suite (tools/src/parse-suite.ts). Game 1.21.0.3.

classifications.reason: The pattern chinese_grid_pattern_01 is written 'name {' at the top level, without its '='. The rest of the file uses 'name = {'; the catalogue's message names a block name and a body, and the block is read as the pattern's.

The file ends inside its last event, gdp_visit_holding_decision_event.1507: the event's own closing brace is missing. Counted outside comments and quoted text, the file has 1,399 '{' and 1,398 '}', and its depth is last zero on line 3838.

A dated entry of a character's history is written '296.1.1 { add_spouse = ... }', without its '='; every other entry has one. The same defect that release 2.3.0 recorded in history/characters/japanese.txt on game 1.20, which 1.21.0.3 no longer has.
